project_type: Vue 3.5 + Vite 6 single-page app with Vuetify 3, Pinia, Vue Router, Leaflet/leaflet.markercluster. Mix of Options API and Options-API-wrapped setup().
build_system: Vite 6 + vue-tsc. `npm run build` = run-p type-check build-only (type-check then vite build). No monorepo; single package at workspace root.
test_framework: Vitest 3 with jsdom environment and @vue/test-utils; Vuetify is inlined via server.deps.inline in vitest.config.ts. Component tests mount with an explicit createVuetify() instance and assert on rendered DOM input values.
test_command: npm run test:unit  (single-run a file with: npx vitest run <path>)
verification_instructions: 1) npm run type-check (vue-tsc --build) must pass. 2) npx vitest run <changed-spec> for the touched area, and npx vitest run for a full no-regression pass, must pass. 3) npm run lint:check (eslint .) must pass with no new errors. Browser/headless (Firefox) is NOT required; the project verifies via jsdom component mounts following src/components/GestorView/__tests__/RegisterEmployee.spec.ts.
environment_constraints: Node ^20.19 || >=22.12. Do not add npm dependencies. Work directly in the workspace (no worktree). Do not push.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present; README documents scripts only. Follow existing code style: inline no-dependency utilities under src/utils, @/ alias maps to src/. Keep ESLint/Prettier clean (npm run lint:check).
key_patterns: Mask pattern lives inline in RegisterEmployee.vue as methods onlyDigits/formatCpf/formatPhone plus computed get/set proxies (cpfInput/phoneInput) that store the MASKED string in formData, with registrar() normalizing to digits-only via onlyDigits() in the payload. CPF capped at 11 digits -> 000.000.000-00. Phone progressive -> (00) 00000-0000, separator index 4 for 10 digits, 5 for 11. PruningMap.vue uses a working v-dialog pattern (importCsvMode ref + <v-dialog v-model> + v-card/v-card-actions) and a notify(text,color) helper; marker creation currently happens inline inside map.on('click') right after a native prompt().
